plan.title: Execute existing ETH-configured EMA Trend Gate with expanded parameter optimization

plan.hypothesis: The existing ema_trend_gate/wfa_config.yaml with expanded parameter ranges (rsi_oversold [25,30,35], rsi_overbought [50-70], hold_bars [96-168]) applied to ETHUSDT will improve Sharpe from prior 0.489 to >0.7, following the BNB pattern where expanded tuning boosted Sharpe 195%

This follows the BNB lesson: asset-specific expanded parameter tuning significantly improves performance.
